content: PS1 shader recipe grounded in three@0.186.1 bundle: vertex snap injected via material.onBeforeCompile (called as material.onBeforeCompile(parameters, renderer), three.module.js:18285) replacing the '#include <project_vertex>' anchor — chunk exists and ends with 'gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mvPosition;' (three.module.js:467), so appended code can snap gl_Position to the internal-pixel grid; customProgramCacheKey (three.module.js:7687) must encode snap params to force recompiles. Order dithering: apply Bayer in display (sRGB-encoded) space at INTERNAL framebuffer pixel coordinates (uv * internalRes), not canvas-pixel gl_FragCoord, so the pattern survives nearest-neighbor upscale; quantize ~5 bits/channel with floor(c*31+bayer)/31. Built-in material fragment tail is tonemapping -> colorspace -> fog -> premultiplied -> dithering (lambert_frag, three.module.js). TSL addons RetroPassNode/Bayer exist in docs but require an addons importmap entry — core-only preferred for this repo.
